(e_other_rule)
(section) SECTION 2 (new 7-13-862)
(quote) Poll managers shall allow poll watchers to sit directly behind the poll managers responsible for voter identification and verification.
(other) SECTION 1 (new 7-13-73): commissioners of election shall attempt to appoint poll managers who represent the racial and gender composition of the precinct.
(other) SECTION 3: takes effect upon approval by the Governor.
(other) version: 2011-01-20_Introduced (only version): no rule on what ID counts; slot e holds the poll-watcher seating rule near the ID check.
(other) note: Does not set or change any ID rule. It only refers to the poll managers who check voter identification. One version.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
